interpretation.historical_covariance_readout: The archived readout starts one unscented filter from the global posterior and propagates covariance and sigma points; it is not a deterministic primary trajectory.
interpretation.ensemble_forecast_control: Each candidate state and parameter vector issues a separate trajectory, after which discharge trajectories are probability weighted.
